items.finding: The source reports that temperature was varied together with acid concentrations and ionic strength to obtain a robust model.
items.how_it_applies: This could support treating temperature as a variable to record or control at the measurement point when developing a calibration for the in-line measurement.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The work is on acidic lithium-recycling liquid-liquid extraction, not dairy whey; it does not test an in-line temperature sensor or dairy matrix.

citation.quote: The concentrations of nitric acid and hydrochloric acid as well as the ionic strength and temperature were varied to obtain a robust model.
